cohort: The study included healthy newborns and their mothers who received banked donor milk during their postpartum hospital stay at a single academic medical center between July 2013 and June 2016.
finding: Utilization of banked donor milk (BDM) for healthy infants increased substantially at the study center from 0.04% of infants before July 2014 to 4.7% in July 2015-June 2016, with a corresponding increase in the number of bottles provided per infant.
followup_time: Until discharge from postpartum hospital stay
